sourceFindings.injection: Exact options.content equality against same original harness construction enforced before forwarding original options. No source transformation/prefix/page-global wrapper; page.evaluate host wrapper still adds bookkeeping.
sourceFindings.pause: Native all-exception pause matching requires original in-flight check, exception description and check frame. Local ({state,size}) read occurs only after original throw using side-effect guard. Actual paused source retained; original assertion substring checked. Unexpected/repeated pauses retained and forbid causalCaptureReady.
sourceFindings.timing: No extra page evaluation before failure. Debugger/tracing themselves change execution, deoptimization and timing. Host call start/end timestamps are not the native event clock; timer/event lifetimes and source stacks must establish attribution independently.
sourceFindings.trace: All raw events retained until300000 limit; dropped events, dataLossOccurred not false, incomplete flush invalidate integrity. Tracing.end and complete wait occur while target VM paused before resume.
sourceFindings.cleanup: Per-CDP command2s/5s bounds, finally resume in pause handler, context cleanup tries stop/join/disable/resume/detach and always real context close; outer browser close plus pause join retained. A failed early cleanup CDP operation skips subsequent diagnostic cleanup operations, but real context close and outer resume/browser close remain attempted and diagnosticCleanupError invalidates evidence.
sourceFindings.sourceStability: Pinned expected-inputs before launch; script/current runtime/harness/checkout after comparisons retained. Page/crash/request/http errors independently invalidate integrity.
sourceFindings.classification: Host outcome records original exception separately from setup/timeout/cleanup; outcome is not causal acceptance. causalCaptureReady only checks raw-data availability; independent exact-match source/lifetime review still mandatory.
sourceFindings.protocolReferences: Official js_protocol.json and browser_protocol.json opened read-only; schema supports paused-frame/script-source and trace lifecycle approach. Installed browser compatibility not executed or assumed.
